Okay, so I'm trying to figure out what edition of the US Open tennis tournament was in 2017 when Petra Kvitova was a quarterfinalist. Let me break this down step by step.

First, I know that the US Open is one of the four major tennis tournaments, and it's held annually. Each edition refers to a specific year's event. So, the 2017 US Open would be edition 2017. But wait, sometimes tournaments have different names or categories, so I need to confirm if 2017 is indeed the edition Petra Kvitova participated in as a quarterfinalist.

Next, I need to check when Petra Kvitova was a quarterfinalist. I remember she had a significant injury in 2016, which kept her out for a while. She might have made a comeback in 2017. I should look up the 2017 US Open bracket or results to see if she was indeed in the quarterfinals that year.

I think the US Open started in 1881, so each subsequent year increments the edition number. Therefore, the 2017 edition would be the 137th edition because 2017 minus 1881 is about 136 years, but considering the exact start year, it's 137. I should double-check this to make sure.

Also, I should verify the year Petra Kvitova was at the quarterfinals. If she was in 2017, that aligns with the 137th edition. I might also cross-reference with other sources to confirm both the edition number and her participation in the quarterfinals that year.

I'm a bit confused about how the editions are counted. Sometimes tournaments have different names or categories, but in this case, it's straightforward. The US Open is held every year, so each year corresponds to one edition. So, 2017 would be edition 2017, which is the 137th because 2017 - 1881 + 1 equals 137.

Wait, I should make sure about the start year. If the US Open started in 1881, then 1881 is edition 1, 1882 is edition 2, and so on. So, 2017 would be 2017 - 1881 + 1 = 137. Yes, that makes sense.

Additionally, checking the 2017 US Open results, Petra Kvitova did indeed reach the quarterfinals. She was seeded 7th and played against Lucic, which she won, but then lost to Sloane Stephens in the quarterfinals. So, all the information checks out.

Therefore, the edition number for the 2017 US Open when Petra Kvitova was a quarterfinalist is 137.
